text:
lena_cs: Morning — snapshot for OrbitPay this week. TL;DR: overall traffic +5% WoW, 5xx up +2.9% driven by two hotspots, timeouts +5.5% (nightly ingestion + bulk embeddings), and a small but visible bump in 429s during their regional peak. Top failing endpoints and windows below.
mike_oncall: drop the list and any correlated infra signals pls.
lena_cs: top offenders: 
- POST /v2/generate/batch \u2014 5xx 1.1% (mostly 502/503), concentrated 01:45-03:00 UTC, aligns with nightly data sync windows
- POST /api/embeddings/multi \u2014 timeouts ~2.5% on batches >30, spike 13:00-14:00 UTC
- POST /v1/events/import \u2014 intermittent timeouts and higher latency during file uploads, 0.7%
- POST /chat/stream/send \u2014 rate_limit (429) increased to 0.8% during 18:00-19:00 local peak
- POST /internal/retry-handler \u2014 5xx 0.4% tied to client retry storms
dave_sre: infra notes 1 - saw a shortdedicated GPU eviction event at 02:12 UTC (kube preempt). 2 - Disk IO queueing on ingest nodes during 01:30-02:15 UTC. linked dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/orbitpay/errors
anya_prod: FYI we enabled larger default batch-size in SDK last Tuesday for some accounts; could be amplifying embeddings and generate issues.
mike_oncall: alert history: alerts-bot: OrbitPay 5xx threshold breached (last 1h=41, thresh=30).
anya_prod: suggested mitigations: 1) gate large batch requests at edge for OrbitPay (soft-limit to 20 items) 2) temporary schedule migration of heavy nightly sync to lower concurrency window 3) client SDK patch to auto-chunk and exponential backoff
lena_cs: renewal touch in 9 days. Customer has flagged reliability in weekly ops call; recommendation = medium-high risk unless we demonstrate quick wins. I'll lead customer comms.
dave_sre: I'll push an edge-rule canary today to limit batch-size and add a short-term capacity bump for 01:30-03:30 UTC tomorrow.
mike_oncall: I'll watch for new alerts and page SRE if breaches persist after throttle.
anya_prod: I'll prepare SDK guidance and a short PR for opt-in rollback of larger batch default (due 48h).
lena_cs: action items:
- dave_sre: edge throttle canary + capacity bump (due: today EOD)
- anya_prod: SDK guidance + opt-in rollback PR (due: 48h)
- lena_cs: renewal brief + customer note (due: before renewal)
- alerts-bot: keep posting and page on >2x threshold
dave_sre: tiny repro for embed timeout (run with --max-time 12):
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings/multi \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items": ["<long text>","..."], "model":"embed-large"}' --max-time 12\n```
lena_cs: thanks all. i'll draft the customer note once the canary shows green and post an update here. :thumbsup:
